name: News of Dogran
summary: In Stonetalon's foothills, Dogran's life hangs on a healing draught from Malaka'jin. The first runner sent to fetch it never returned, and you travel deep into the foothills to find Ken'zigla, a Darkspear troll.

sections.title: A Plea Across the Frontier
sections.body: Dogran, a Horde grunt at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, was badly wounded fighting entrenched quilboar. His fellow grunts brought him back, but his wounds had festered. They feared moving him without first treating him. Taurajo sent word north to the Crossroads for a traditional healing draught made by the jungle trolls of Malaka'jin.

sections.title: Bloodshed at Malaka'jin
sections.body: At Malaka'jin, you learn the first courier sent for the medicine was killed by goblins before he could bring it back. Ken'zigla still has the draught Dogran needs. Getting it means facing the dangers along the Stonetalon passes.

faq.q: Who is Dogran and why is he hurt?
faq.answer: Dogran is a Horde grunt at Camp Taurajo. He was badly wounded fighting quilboar in the southern Barrens, and his wounds festered until moving him seemed too dangerous without treatment.
Malaka'jin is a Darkspear troll outpost in the rocky base of the Stonetalon Mountains, just beyond the Barrens' northwestern border.

faq.q: What happened to the first messenger sent for the draught?
faq.answer: Goblins killed the first courier from the Crossroads near Malaka'jin before he could bring back Ken'zigla's draught. Ken'zigla says only that the goblins killed him.

faq.q: Why do warlock trainers care about Dogran's fate?
faq.answer: Warlock initiates receive an errand for Blind Cazul and Gazrog under the guise of helping Dogran. The ordeal leads them to an artifact tied to love and heartbreak, needed to summon and bind a succubus.
Ken'zigla is a Darkspear troll alchemist and herbalist at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon. He knows how to brew potent wilderness draughts.

faq.q: Why could Dogran not be moved directly to a city?
faq.answer: After the fight with the quilboar, Dogran's wounds festered badly. His fellow soldiers feared the rough Barrens roads to a major healer would kill him before he arrived.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face what seems to be a military mercy mission. Cazul and Orgrimmar's warlocks have set a trial that leads you toward the feelings needed to bind a succubus.
As a member of the Horde, you see how fragile the supply routes are between Camp Taurajo and the isolated camp at Malaka'jin, with quilboar and goblins threatening the way.
